Class RamBlock

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.netlist.xilinx.RamBlock

  • public class RamBlock
extends java.lang.Object
    This class contains parameters describing a registered memory block.     • Method Detail

      • RAMB

        public void RAMB()
        Construct a dual port RAMB4. Only the following combinations of widths are allowed - 
         address data
   8      16 (256 deep x 16 bits)
   9       8 (512 deep x 8 bits)
  10       4 (1024 deep x 4 bits)
  11       2 (2048 deep x 2 bits)
  12       1 (4096 deep x 1 bit)

      • RAMB4

   9      8  (512 deep x 8 bits)
  10      4  (1024 deep x 4 bits)
  11      2  (2048 deep x 2 bits)
  12      1  (4096 deep x 1 bit)

      • RAMB18_RAMB36

        private void RAMB18_RAMB36()
        Construct a dual port RAMB18, RAMB18SDP, RAMB36 or RAMB36SDP. Only the following combinations of widths are allowed - 
         address RAMB18 data  RAMB36 data
  10     18           36         (1024 deep)
  11      9           18         (2048 deep)
  12      4            9         (4096 deep)
  13      2            4         (8192 deep)
  14      1            2         (16384 deep)
  15      -            1         (32768 deep)

      • raminit

        private static void raminit(Element e,
                            int init_lines,
                            java.lang.String[] init,
                            int dwidth,
                            int pwidth)
        Initialise block RAM. The initialisation array is null if there is no initialisation. Trailing entries in the initialisation array may be null.
        Parameters:
        e - is the element
        init_lines - is the number of main initialisation lines
        init - is an array of binary strings, one for each word, the length of each being the block data width
        dwidth - is the block data width
        pwidth - is the block parity width
